lines.t:
CHAPTER 10
Return to Nexa
The same apartment block. The same cracked doorstep. Peter knocks.
The door opens.
…Peter?
Hi, Mom. I'm home.
She doesn't speak. She just holds him, the way she did in the hospital ten years ago — so tightly it hurts. He doesn't complain.
Ten years. Ten years, Peter. Where were you?
I survived in a jungle. I trained every day. I'm sorry I couldn't call.
A jungle.
Elena looks at him the way she used to look at villains. Then the way she used to look at her husband.
You stand differently. You breathe differently. The air feels… heavier around you.
You look like your father, Peter. More every second.
Is that a bad thing?
No. It's the best thing I've seen in ten years. …Sit down. I'm making dinner, and you're going to eat all of it.
The next morning. His old bedroom — unchanged, dusted every week for ten years.
Time to go back to school. The Academy's Hero Division still accepts students who never graduated.
His phone lights up with breaking news: a Grand Power Competition, hosted by Professor Hale. Registration closes in three days. The four crew leaders have already entered.
Professor Hale… He always believed in me.
Call Professor Hale using your phone (Phone → Calls) to register in secret.

scenes.title: Back at the Academy

lines.t: Nexa Academy. The rankings screen is bigger now. His name isn't on it at all.
…No way. No WAY.
Hey, John. Sorry I'm late.
LATE?! Ten years, you idiot! I— I copied a tracking power, a telepath, a seer— I looked EVERYWHERE—
John grabs him in a hug that would crack a normal person's ribs.
You owe me so much ramen. Like, ten years of ramen.
I know. I saved you a bowl.
Well, well. The runaway returns. Here to watch the competition from the cheap seats?
Something like that.
Nobody knows I've registered. Good.

scenes.hint: Call Professor Hale on your phone to register for the competition.
